item.title: Plush Toy Sourcing Guide: Fabric, Filling and Fire Safety
item.description: A plush toy is only as good as its fabric weight, filling and stitching. How to write a spec sheet Chinese factories can quote from, the five QC checks that catch bad batches, and where EN71-2 fire testing actually bites.

item.title: EN71, ASTM F963 and GPSR: Which Toy Certificate You Need Where
item.description: A country-by-country map of what a toy actually needs: EN71 for the EU, ASTM F963 and CPC for the US, plus the EU responsible person rule under GPSR that catches most importers.

item.title: Toy Safety Certifications Explained: CE, EN71, ASTM F963, GPSR
